description:
Returns each Client's personal records link for a Quarter and a ready-to-paste message for a messaging app or text.
Use this when: the practitioner wants to send a link themselves (no email on file, or they prefer a messaging app or text).

quarter.description: Quarter like "2026-27 Q3". Default: the Quarter whose HMRC deadline is next.
